english_outline.section_1_main_conclusion: Amazon Q2 2026 beat estimates. AWS grew 36.7% year over year, its fastest in 18 quarters. Operating income rose 43%. Reuters reported shares jumped. The EPS beat was inflated by a $53.4 billion non-operating gain from Anthropic investments.
english_outline.section_2_core_business_changes: AWS revenue reached $42.2 billion with a 39% operating margin. AI and chips businesses each passed a $25 billion annual run rate. Advertising grew 26%. North America and International segments grew 16% and 15%. Amazon lifted 2026 capital spending guidance to about $220 billion for AI and cloud infrastructure.
english_outline.section_3_expectations: Operating income grew faster than revenue, showing operating leverage. But trailing-twelve-month free cash flow turned to a $7.6 billion outflow because capital purchases rose $66.1 billion. Q3 guidance implies a sequential slowdown due to Prime Day timing and foreign exchange. Management said Q3 growth would be nearly 400 basis points higher excluding the Prime Day effect.
english_outline.section_4_market_pricing: Shares rose 9.15% in after-hours trading to $257.04 after a 3.9% regular-session gain. Investing.com reported the stock trades at a 28.6 P/E and a 0.74 PEG ratio. The market looked past higher spending. No named institution ratings or target prices were given in the sources.
english_outline.section_5_next_quarter_validation: The key validation point is whether AWS growth stays near 37% without the Prime Day boost. Investors will also watch whether the $220 billion capital spending plan starts to pressure free cash flow or AWS margins.

reader_questions: 净利润626亿美元中534亿美元来自对Anthropic投资的非经营性收益，剔除后本季度的核心盈利质量是否仍支撑'全面超预期'的结论？
自由现金流从182亿美元流入转为76亿美元流出，而资本支出指引上调至约2200亿美元，市场为何仍以9.15%的盘后涨幅回应？
AWS 37%的增速中有多少来自Prime Day时间转移等一次性因素，剔除后第三季度能否维持接近该水平的增速？
checks: 核查公司原文：净利润626亿美元确含534亿美元非经营性税前其他收益，主要来自Anthropic投资；营业利润275亿美元、增长43%为经营性口径。原稿已作区分，但未说明剔除后EPS超预期的幅度会显著收窄，修订稿需明确这一口径差异对'超预期'结论的影响。
核查公司原文与Investing.com：过去十二个月经营现金流增长33%至1614亿美元，自由现金流转为76亿美元流出，主因不动产和设备采购净额同比增加661亿美元；管理层将2026年资本支出指引上调至约2200亿美元。Investing.com报道盘后涨9.15%至257.04美元，并称市场似乎愿意暂时忽略更高支出计划。原稿表述与来源一致，但需补上'市场定价与现金流压力并存'这一张力。
核查Investing.com：AWS收入422亿美元、增长36.7%，为18个季度最快；管理层称第二季度到第三季度环比放缓主要反映Prime Day时间转移和汇率逆风，剔除Prime Day影响第三季度同比增速本应高出近400个基点。原稿已引用该表述，但未点明Prime Day落在第二季度是AWS之外整体营收的一次性提振，修订稿需将其作为验证点前置。
